visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: Managed default and user picker converge only at session initialization. The MCP activation barrier is separate. Fix selects agent mode when available, with worktree and reviewed diff downstream, otherwise ask mode. No claim that every deployment is correctly governed.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: Synthetic tasks and decision rules enter the evaluation sandbox. Finance, security and legal checks are independently visible. Criterion-level expected and observed states support training analysis and human review; no benchmark-wide performance result is invented.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: Session, semantic, procedural and episodic memory are distinct context layers around a scoped agent. Skills and tools remain separate registries. Identity, authorization, sandbox, gateway and audit controls bound action rather than claiming autonomous general access.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: Three interaction surfaces feed a process graph grounded in records and business rules. The deterministic workflow precedes separate approval, monitoring and override controls, which converge on an audited transaction. No SAP logo or claim of uncontrolled autonomy appears.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: Immutable source and SKILL.md enter independent metadata and repository-license evidence checks. Missing license data is not normalized to no restriction. Network, filesystem and credential side effects feed a write-blocked sandbox before named approval and adopt/reject.

images.alt_text: Customer inquiry, read-only CRM and inventory snapshot feed a bounded role. Draft, confidence and spend-cap controls precede human approval, while a no-auto-send barrier blocks bypass. Approved work separates into response, inventory proposal and audit record.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: Three bounded inputs feed a role with drafting, confidence and spend-cap controls. Human approval is mandatory; the red no-auto-send path blocks an unreviewed bypass. Outputs separate response, inventory proposal and audit record. Early access prevents a general-availability implication.

set_review.differentiation_evidence: Six inspected saved PNGs use different causal grammars: JetBrains branching session/tool controls; Ironclad radial evaluation bench; Gemini concentric memory-and-governance architecture; SAP layered enterprise process stack; SkillMD diagonal provenance/side-effect intake; and SMB bounded-role approval flow. Palettes, hierarchy, geometry and annotation patterns remain visibly distinct.
